title: Saraswati Ashtakam
intro: Saraswati Ashtakam is a sacred hymn dedicated to Goddess Saraswati. Read the complete lyrics, meaning, and benefits.
description:
Shri Saraswati Ashtakam

|| shatanika uvacha ||
mahamate mahaprajna
sarvashastravisharada |
akshinakarmabandhastu
purusho dvijasattama ||1||
marane yajjopejjapyam
yam cha bhavamanusmaran |
param padamavapnoti
tanme bruhi mahamune ||2||

|| shaunaka uvacha ||
idameva maharaja
prishtavamste pitamahah |
bhishmam dharmavidam shreshtham
dharmaputro yudhishtirah ||3||

|| yudhishthira uvacha ||
pitamaha mahaprajna
sarvashastravisharadah |
brihaspatistuta devi
vagishena mahatmana |
atmayam darshayamasam
surya kotisamaprabham ||4||

|| sarasvatyuvacha ||
varam vrinishva bhadram
te yatte manasi vidyate |

|| brihaspatiruvacha ||
yadi me varada devi
divyajnanam prayachchha nah ||5||

|| devyuvacha ||
hanta te nirmalajnanam
kumatidhvamsakaranam |
stotrananena yo bhaktya
mam stuvanti manishinah ||6||

|| brihaspatiruvacha ||
labhate paramam jnanam
yataparairapi durlabham |
prapnoti purusho nityam
mahamaya prasadatah ||7||

|| sarasvatyuvacha ||
trisandhyam prayato nityam
pathedashtakamuttamam |
tasya kanthe sada vasam
karishyami na sanshayah ||8||

|| iti shri-padma-purane saraswati ashtakam sampurnam ||

faq.q1: From which text is Shri Saraswati Ashtakam taken?
faq.a1: This sacred stotra is compiled from the Padma Purana.
faq.q2: Whose dialogue is primarily described in this stotra?
faq.a2: It describes the dialogue between Devarshi Brihaspati and Goddess Saraswati, which is presented through the dialogue of Yudhishthira and Bhishma within the conversation between King Satanika and Sage Shaunaka.
faq.q3: What boon did Devarshi Brihaspati ask from Goddess Saraswati?
faq.a3: Brihaspati asked Goddess Saraswati for the boon of divine knowledge (pure knowledge), which destroys evil intellect and ignorance.
faq.q4: What are the benefits of reciting Shri Saraswati Ashtakam?
faq.a4: Through its regular recitation, the seeker attains rare supreme knowledge, and Goddess Saraswati permanently resides on their tongue (speech and intellect).
faq.q5: When should this Ashtakam be recited?
faq.a5: It is considered extremely fruitful to recite it daily during trisandhya (morning, noon, and evening) with a pure and disciplined mind.
